questions.q: Geeta walks 9 m West, then turns left and walks 2 m, then turns right and walks 3 m. Which direction is Geeta facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the West. GPSC-style practice item.

The present ages of Pooja and Geeta are in the ratio 3 : 4. After 2 years the ratio will be 10 : 13. What is Geeta's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 3k and 4k: (3k + 2)/(4k + 2) = 10/13 gives k = 6, so Geeta is 24. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Pooja walks 8 m South, then turns left and walks 7 m, then turns right and walks 8 m. Which direction is Pooja facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the South. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the next letter in the series: Z, X, U, Q, L, ?
questions.why: The steps back are 2, 3, 4, 5, then 6. L is the 12th letter, so the next is the 6th, F.

In a group of 40 people, 26 like Hindi, 16 like English and 3 like neither. How many like only Hindi?
questions.why: Both = 26 + 16 − (40 − 3) = 5; only Hindi = 26 − 5 = 21. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next? ABC, EFG, IJK, MNO, …
questions.why: Each group starts 4 letters after the last one, with the same pattern inside: QRS. GPSC-style practice item.
